summary: 24 entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: 24: The Game

emulation.notes: Use original PS2 hardware when available; otherwise document PCSX2 version/settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 hardware with region and capture chain documented

primary.version: Original PS2 release on hardware or PCSX2
primary.why: 24: The Game is a PlayStation 2-exclusive licensed action-adventure, so the archive route is original PS2 hardware or carefully documented PS2 emulation. There is no native PC/current-storefront route.
primary.how_to_play: Use original PS2 hardware with capture hardware or PCSX2 from a legally owned disc. Record disc region, emulator/version or hardware model, controller, deinterlacing/upscale settings, difficulty, chapter, and any FMV/audio sync issues.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster/current storefront route is documented.
